author: marthomahew
name: guide
short: An interactive guide to Refbot with a topic dropdown.
description: `[p]guide post #channel` posts a panel with a "Pick a topic…" dropdown explaining every Refbot feature; each topic opens privately. `/guide` opens it privately anywhere.
install_msg: Loaded? `[p]guide post #bot-guide`. For the slash version: `[p]slash enable guide` then `[p]slash sync`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data.
